caption: The drawing features two objects, both colored in various shades of dark green, brown, and black, suggesting a metallic surface with reflective highlights. The top object is a three-dimensional lid resembling the head of an animal, specifically a pig, with defined ears, snout, eyes, and a handle-like feature on top. The bottom object is a larger, horizontal, three-dimensional depiction of a reclining pig, including prominent features such as a curled tail, ears, snout, and closed eyes, all resting on a base that matches the shape of the animal. The pig's body is detailed with natural contours and shading to indicate depth and form, and the lid above aligns with the pig's head, suggesting they are parts of the same covered dish. The background is a plain, light beige color with no additional elements or shading. There is small, handwritten text in the lower left and right corners.
title: Pa. German Cake Mold
